rows.name: size
rows.description: The size of the checkbox icon, can be small or large.

rows.name: checked
rows.description: Indicates whether the checkbox icon is checked.

rows.name: error
rows.description: Indicates whether there is an error state.

rows.name: indeterminate
rows.description: Indicates whether the checkbox icon is in an indeterminate state.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Controls the disabled status of the checkbox icon.

rows.name: readonly
rows.description: Controls the read-only status of the checkbox icon.

rows.name: checkmarkIcon
rows.description: Icon displayed when checkbox is checked. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component

rows.name: minusIcon
rows.description: Icon displayed when indeterminate is set to true. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component

rows.name: onCheckedChange
rows.description: Function that is called when the selected state of the component changes.
